information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public.

IS  :  1755  -  1983 

Indian  Standard 

METHOD  FOR 
WRAPPING  TEST  FOR  METALLIC  WIRE 

(  First  Revision ) 


0-    FOREWORD 

0.1  This  Indian  Standard  (  First  Revision  )  was  adopted  by  the  Indian 
Standaids  Imriiution  on  27  June  1983,  after  the  draft  finalized  by  the 
Methods  of  Physical  Tests  Sectional  Committee  had  beeji  approved  by 
the  Structural  and  Metals  Division  CounciL 

0.2  This  Indian  Standard  was  fust  published  in  l*J6I.  Subsequently, 
it  was  decided  by  the  concerned  sectional  committee  to  revise  this 
standard  so  as  to  have  a  single  reference  in  Indian  Standard  on  method 
for  wrappmg  tebt  on  metal  tic  wire.  So  this  standard,  supersedes 
IS  :  4168-1967*  and  IS  :  3368^  1 965^  as  the  requirements  of  these 
standards  have  been  covered  now  in  this  standard. 

0,3  In  the  preparation  of  this  standard^  assistance  has  been  derived  from 
the  following  standards  published  by  the  International  Organization  for 
SlandarcUzaiion: 

ISO  R  145-1960         Wtappmg  test  for  steei  wire 

ISO  R  958-1969         Wrapping  test  for  aluminium  and  aluminium 

alloy  wire 
ISO  R  397-1964         Wrappmi^j   test   for    copper     and   copper  alloy 


0.4  Certain  specific  requirements  have  to  be  specified  in  the  material 
specification  where  reference  has  been  made  to  this  standard.  For 
convenience  of  reference,  the^e  requirements  iiave  been  summarized 
and  mcludcd  in  Appendix  A, 

0-5  In  reporting  the  result  of  a  test  or  analysis  made  in  accordance  with 
this  stand  aid,  if  the  final  value,  observed  or  calculated^  is  to  be  rounded 
off,  it  shall  Ije  done  in  accoi dance  with  IS  :  2- 1960 J. 


*Mctliutl  fur  wtjppitig  leit  of  alumuuum  and  aluminium  alloy  wire, 
f  Method  of  wrappmg  te^t  for  copper  and  copper  alloy  wire. 
JR'ilri  foi  Njundmg  offninner/cai  values  (  recited  ). 


IS  :  1755  •  1983 

1-  SCOPE 

1.1  This  standard  prescribes  the  method  fnr  conducting  wrappping  test 
of  metallic  wires  circular  in  cross  section^  up  to  5*0  mm. 

2.  PRINCIPLE  OF  TEST 

2.1  The  test  consists  of  winding  the  wire  a  specified  mimher  of  turns 
around  a  mandrel  of  the  diameter  stated  in  ihe  materials  specification. 
If  may  also  include  unwinding  or  unwinding  and  rewinding  to  a  specified 
number  of  turns. 

2.1,1  The  lest  shall  bo  carried  out  M  ambient  temperature,  unless 
nihrrwjse  specified  The  ambient  lenipeiaturc  during  test  should  be 
recorded 

3.  TEST  PIECE 

3.1  The  test  piece  shall  bo  a  piece  of  wire  ofsiiflKicnt  length  to  enable 
the  test  to  be  made 

4.  TESTING  MACHINE 

4.1  The  testing  machine  used  shall  be  so  constructed  ihat  the  wire  may 
be  wound  in  helix,  tightly  around  the  mandiel  so  that  adjacent  coils  are 
in  contact.  A  piece  of  wire  to  bo  tested  may  be  used  as  the  mandrel 
provided  it  is  of  the  specified  mandrel  djamoirr. 

5-  TEST  PROCEDURE 

5*1  The  test  f)iece  shall  be  wound  round  the  mandrel  at  a  constant  speedy 
sufficiently  slow  to  prevent  any  rise  in  temperature  likely  to  afiVct  the 
lesult  of  the  test.  To  ensure  light  winding  a  tensile  stress  not  exceeding 
fi  percent  of  the  nominal  tensile  strengih  of  the  wire  may  be  applied 
durinj3  winding. 

5.2  If  unwinding  or  nnvvindmg  and  rewinding  are  ^specified,  the  rate  of 
luiwinding  or  rewinding  shall  he  suflicientiy  slow  to  pro\ent  any  rise  in 
temperatures  likely  to  affect  the  result  ot  the  test.  At  leabi  one  turn  sliall 
be  left  unwound. 

6*  TEST  REQUIREMENTS 

6.1  At  the  end  of  the  tesi,  the  test  piece  shall  be  examined.  The  inter- 
pietation  of  tlie  appearance  of  the  tested  portion  shall  be  done  in 
accordance  with  the  material  specificalion. 


IS  :  1755  -  1983 

APPENDIX    A 

(  Clause  0.4  ) 

REQUIREMENTS  TO  BE  SPECIFIED  IN  MATERIAL 
SPECIFICATION  FOR  WIRE  AND  WIRE  PRODUCTS 

A-1.  In  the  material  specifiration  for  wire  and  wire  products  where 
reference  to  this  standard  has  been  made,  the  following  points  shall  be 
specified  for  wrapping  test: 

a)  The   length   of  wire  and  the  number  of  turns  for  winding  or  for 
winding  and  unwinding  (  see  2.1  and  3.1  ), 

b)  The  diameter  of  the  mandrel   round    which    the    wire   is    to   be 
wound  (  see2,\  ), 

c)  Speed  of  winding  (  see  5.1  ),  and 

d)  The   interpretation   of  the   visual    appearance  of  the  test  pieces 
after  the  test  (  see  6,1  ).
